description: Known zone ids are never renamed (§3.6). A calendar holding an event made in Thirteen in Europe/Tallinn (with its generated VTIMEZONE for 2026), then a Google export and an Apple export that both use Europe/Tallinn with their own, different VTIMEZONEs: nothing is renamed, every imported group is stored byte for byte (plus its baseline line), and the document keeps one Europe/Tallinn VTIMEZONE, Thirteen's, rebuilt for the years the imported events reach (2026-2027, then 2025-2027). The same imports into an empty calendar keep the Google file's VTIMEZONE.

scenarios.name: Into a calendar with a Thirteen event
